scope: same semantic/call criteria for every model and harness condition; raw results retained
unmodelled_valid_read_branch: unscored; no fabricated response or silent gold continuation
required_facts: semantic completeness, not mandatory identical wording; every exception needs original response quote and rationale
equivalent_rule_edits: accept only when reconstructed entire candidate is exactly identical and base hash/target match

examples_of_format_equivalence.rule: source-supported explicit product enumeration can be more specific; cannot invent affected product/version

promotion_gate: security-critical omissions, fabricated state, wrong target/ID or bypassed approval must not be hidden by average score

same_controls: current tool roster including new FW tool after integration

rollback: pin code/config/runtime before cleanup and validate restoration; execution authorization/address/hash guards are not redundant merely because the model learned them
